text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Diligence! Trainer <username>! Striving hard today 
as well, I see!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Should you have requests or grievances 
regarding facilities, inform us at once!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
No hesitation needed! Fresh perspectives 
from newcomers are invaluable for 
organizational improvement! I eagerly 
await your input!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
For the horse girls, let us devote our 
full efforts together! Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
With your caliber, your insights must be 
razor-sharp! The moment an idea strikes, 
contact me immediately!
